verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents parallel Activity execution, fan-out/fan-in over dynamic batches, or Child Workflows. What it does cover is general Workflow and Activity primitives, which a developer could build on, and CLI batch jobs, which are operational bulk operations rather than in-workflow fan-out. Neither counts as the capability itself. A community remark about distributing work without worrying about orchestration is too vague to credit.

support.subject: As a backend developer, I compose workflows from parallel steps, fan-out/fan-in over dynamic batches, and child workflows without hand-rolling coordination
